verses.1: At the age of fifty-five years, during the beginning of that year, on the twentieth day of the month, fourteen years after the city was completely destroyed. On this day, it was in the hands of Jehovah, and He brought me there.
verses.2: In the sight of God, He brought me to the land of Israel. He placed me on a very high mountain, and on that mountain there was a city built upon it.
verses.3: And he brought me there. There, a man appeared to him; he resembled a scorpion in appearance. He had a net in his hands. Then he stood in the doorway.
verses.4: And the man who was called Adam spoke to me. He said, “See with your eyes and hear with your ears everything I see. Remember all that I show you. For it is for your sake that I have brought these things before you.”
verses.5: And behold, there was a fire outside the house, all around it. In the man’s hand, he burned six sticks of wood. He burned them all at once, and then he stood up. One stick of wood was burned, and another one was also burned.
verses.6: And he went to the gate whose front was towards the east. He stood on its steps and measured the width of the gate’s doorframe. One side of the doorframe was measured, and one side was also measured.
verses.7: And each door was long in length, and each door was wide in width. Between the doors were five feet apart. The edge of the door, from outside, was also long. But the edge of the door from inside the house was shorter.
verses.8: And he measured the door of the house from the inside to the outside.
verses.9: And he measured the door; its width was two cubits, and its height was also two cubits. The door was measured from the ceiling down.
verses.10: And the doors of the gate are three feet wide on each side. One foot is from one side to the other, and one foot is from the left to the right.
verses.11: And he measured the width of the door entrance to be twelve amots. The length of the door entrance was thirteen amots.
verses.12: And before the times, there was one hour, and another hour. There was also six hours from that point, and six more hours from that point.
verses.13: And he made the door from the top of the roof to its wide roof. It was forty-five hours in length, with a door facing the entrance.
verses.14: And he made sixty oxen, and also oxen for the gates around the city.
verses.15: And on the front of the outer door, there is a distance of fifty amahs between that door and the inner door.
verses.16: And the closed chambers were placed around the doors, and also around the inner parts of the building. Similarly, there were also enclosed chambers around the doors, and around the inner parts of the building.
verses.17: And he brought me to the beautiful courtyard. There were walls and floors made of stone, surrounding the entire courtyard. There were thirty walls that connected the different parts of the courtyard to the ground.
verses.18: And the roof of the gates, for the duration of those gates. The lower part of the roof.
verses.19: And Rovach stood in front of the low door, in front of the inner courtyard. This place was located about a hundred meters away from the east and west sides.
verses.20: And the gate, whose front face was directed towards the courtyard of the Hitzonah, had a certain length and width.
verses.21: And its sides were three feet wide, and its height was also three feet. Its entrance was like the first door: it was fifty cubits in length and fifty cubits in width.
verses.22: And their doors, and their windows, and their balconies were like the gates through which people went. Above them stood seven altars, and their windows faced towards them.
verses.23: And the door to the inner courtyard faced towards the doors leading to the outer courtyard and the Kadiim. It was located between two doors, one leading from the inner courtyard and the other leading to the outer courtyard.
verses.24: And he led me along the path of the drom. There I saw the gate of the drom. Its oxen and calves were as large as these ones.
verses.25: And around him and his enemies, they spread out in a circle. The circumference of this circle was fifty amahs in length, and fifty amahs in width.
verses.26: And they raised up seven stairs and their gates before them. Then one of them went to his master, and another went to his brother.
verses.27: And the gate to the inner courtyard was located along the hallway. It was a distance of about one hundred meters from the gate to the inner courtyard, along the hallway.
verses.28: And he brought me to the inner courtyard through the door of the gate. He closed the door of the gate as it was.
verses.29: And his oxen, his sheep, and his cattle were all destroyed according to these laws. They died around him, with a circumference of fifty amahs in length and forty-five amahs in width.
verses.30: And there were walls around it, with a total length of fifty and twenty meters, and a width of fifty meters.
verses.31: And Elamaw went to the gate of the city. He tied his sheep to it, and he placed them on top of it.
verses.32: And he brought me to the inner courtyard, through the entrance. He closed the door behind me, just as it was before.
verses.33: And his walls and his gates, as well as the gates around them, were all built according to these laws. They were surrounded by walls that were fifty cubits in length and fifty and ten cubits in width.
verses.34: And they go into the outer courtyard. They climb up to it from above and from below. The heights are very high above them.
verses.35: And he brought me to the gate of the wilderness, and he measured it according to these measurements.
verses.36: He was surrounded by his enemies and foes. His surroundings were fifty meters in length and fifty-two meters in width.
verses.37: And his cattle go into the courtyard. They are driven towards his cattle from all directions. And there are also those who climb up on top of them.
verses.38: And they opened it with the gates of the gates. There, they would set the upper part in place.
verses.39: And in those two gates, two doors were set up from outside. These doors were used to let in sin and evil.
verses.40: And to the shoulder on the upper side, leading to the entrance of the northern gate. There are two arches there. And to the other shoulder, which is opposite the southern gate. There are also two arches there.
verses.41: Four columns from the front, and four columns from the side towards the door. These columns will be used for sacrifices.
verses.42: And four baskets for the offerings were prepared. Each basket was one and a half meters in length, one and a half meters in width, and one meter in height. These baskets were placed there, along with all the offerings that would be used during the sacrifice.
verses.43: And the ashes were spread out around the house, from one corner to another. They were also carried to the altars in the place of sacrifice.
verses.44: And from the inner door, towards the rooms in the inner courtyard. The entrance to this courtyard is at the end of the hallway leading to the outer door. Their faces face in the direction of the hallway leading to the outer door.
verses.45: And he spoke to me about this “Zoh Lishkha” – a place whose direction was along the road leading to the priests who were in charge of guarding the temple.
verses.46: And the altar, whose front was facing towards the priests who were responsible for guarding the altar. These were the descendants of Sodom, who brought offerings to God.
verses.47: The courtyard was about a hundred meters long and wide, with a square shape. The altar stood in front of the house.
verses.48: He brought me to the house of Elam. There, he stood before me for five hours. The width of the gate was three hours from there, and three hours from there as well.
verses.49: The length of it was forty amahs, and its width was fifteen amahs. And on its top, there were two poles, one on each side.
